main_text.l: Doricé ex ζω futurum σω mutat σ in ξ: ut βαδίζω βαδίσω, vado, am: βα-διξῶ.
Atticé polysyllabum ex ιζω in ισω,
circumflectitur ultima, & tollitur σ, ut νομίζω, νομίσω, puto, bo: νομιῶ.
Vbi figurativa est ρ, λ, μ, ν. Si figu-
rativa fit é liquidis, non assumitur σ,
tem, tollendo é geminis vel liquidis,
ἐλαύνω ἐλᾱσῶ, ab ἐλάω, agito, bo.

page.notes: Greek and accented forms transcribed approximately from the scan; some accents and breathings may be misread. Long s rendered as s. Printed text is a Greek grammar with Latin commentary; the wording "ἀπερῶ" and some Greek forms are doubtful and should be checked against the original.
